title: fix(desktop): the workspaces hint sits in the header row, off the page
body:
## Why The 0.16.0 release candidate (https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/430) is blocked on one red E2E test: `e2e/library-actions.e2e.ts › rename persists the new title and renames the file to match`. It failed twice (first attempt and retry) with the same cause: ``` locator.click: Timeout 30000ms exceeded. - New: workspaces — keep work and personal captures… from
subtree intercepts pointer events ``` The one-time "New: workspaces" hint floated under the workspace switcher, over the top of the page. On the item page that is exactly where the Rename pencil sits, so the hint hid the pencil and swallowed its click. A real user hit the same thing: Rename did nothing until they pressed "Got it". The spec says the hint "does not cover … and does not block clicks outside itself". `Merge requirements` and `Release candidate verified` on #430 are red only because they mirror this E2E result. ## What The hint moves into the header row, right of the switcher bar, instead of floating under it: - `workspace-switcher.module.css`: `.anchor` lays the bar and the hint side by side; `.hint` is an in-flow 30 px pill (no absolute position, no z-index, no shadow) that shrinks before the bar does. `.hintText` truncates with an ellipsis, and "Got it" never truncates. - `workspace-switcher.tsx`: the hint text gets that class plus a `title` tooltip with the full text. The first commit tried `pointer-events: none` on the card. Review (Wachiman) pointed out that the opaque card still painted over the pencil, so that approach was replaced. The E2E test is not changed: it is the regression check for this fix. ## Verification - `bun run verify` passes locally (workflow rules, lint, format, build, types, all unit tests). - Layout checked without Electron: the real `app-shell` and switcher CSS modules plus tokens in headless Chrome at 720 px (window minimum), 1180 px and 1440 px. The hint stays in the header row, never overlaps the item page's title or pencil, and at 720 px it truncates without touching the "IN · …" chip. - The desktop E2E suite only runs automatically on release-please branches, so it was started by hand with `workflow_dispatch` on this branch (it was not run locally; Electron is not run on the owner machine): - https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41405170429 at `90ea5d1c`: the rename test passed, but `export` failed twice and `mute-export` once (see the race below). - https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41405986927 at `61417189`: **20 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky**, and every other job in the workflow green. ## Second fix: openEditor raced the editor mount `e2e/helpers/launch.ts › openEditor` clicked "Edit video" and then waited for any `
